name: recall-gate
why: The margin gate (RECALL_MIN_MARGIN 0.10 over the median, RECALL_MIN_SCORE 0.45, 3-word minimum) was calibrated on 8 documents and 13 queries. This is a larger probe: 20 durable user turns, plus 3 small-talk user turns (>= RECALL_MIN_TEXT, so a live index does hold them) in a second variant, and 25 queries — 14 relevant, 11 irrelevant. Relevant queries should retrieve the right turn; greetings and chit-chat should retrieve nothing. Deterministic given the embedder — no LLM, one pass per variant. Some relevant queries are deliberately inferential (cake -> diabetic, Wednesday -> chess) and are expected to be harder.
docs: I'm allergic to shellfish, properly allergic, I carry an EpiPen everywhere.
My sister Nadia is a paramedic in Leeds.

My dog Moss is a border collie, she herds the neighbour's kids.

I'm saving up to replace the Kestrel's old sails.
